item.summary: fix(plugins): reject malformed percent-encoding in local JSON Schema $ref anchors (#120254) …$ref anchors resolveLocalRef decoded plain-anchor fragments with a bare decodeURIComponent while the pointer branch already tolerated bad escapes via decodePointerSegment's try/catch. A schema carrying $ref: "#%" (a single typo'd hand-written anchor) made findJsonSchemaShapeError throw a raw URIError that escaped validateJsonSchemaValue, crashing plugin/channel config validation, doctor, and gateway startup with a message that pointed nowhere near the offending schema. Decode anchor fragments with the same tolerance: a malformed escape now resolves to { found: false } and surfaces as the intended ".$ref: unresolved ref" diagnostic. Co-authored-by: Tak Hoffman
